name: LCM renoise with s_noise ramp and noise clip
plain: LCM replaces x by the prediction each step, then fully re-noises it to the next sigma using the model's noise_scaling. This core version adds a linear ramp on the noise multiplier and an optional clamp of injected noise.
math: x ← x0. If σ_next>0: ε = sampler(σ,σ_next); if noise_clip_std>0: ε clamped to ±noise_clip_std·std(ε). s_i = s_noise + (s_noise_end−s_noise)·i/(N−1); ε←ε·s_i; x ← noise_scaling(σ_next, ε, x).

props.normalizes_variance: no: clipping reduces variance and nothing restores it
